name: What is the average number of unique product categories per customer per year?
python_code:
# Extract year from InvoiceDate and count unique product categories per customer per year
df['InvoiceDate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['InvoiceDate'])
df['Year'] = df['InvoiceDate'].dt.year

# Filter out rows with missing Customer ID
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Customer ID']).copy()

# Count unique product categories (StockCode) per customer per year
customer_year_categories = df_clean.groupby(['Customer ID', 'Year'])['StockCode'].nunique().reset_index()
customer_year_categories.rename(columns={'StockCode': 'unique_categories'}, inplace=True)

# Calculate average number of unique product categories per customer per year
result = customer_year_categories['unique_categories'].mean()
